text:
Maya: thinking out loud — we need an "audit-mode" for route-level logging so SRE can temporarily capture full req/resp for hard-to-repro bugs. want feedback on policy + console UX.
Derek: +1 for a short-lived breakglass. must be deterministic sampling when not in audit-mode though. hash-based sampling by user_id or request_id.
Linh: hold up — if we capture full bodies we need field-level redaction profiles. otherwise we're leaking PII into logs. can we support per-route redaction schemas?
Maya: proposed config snippet: ```json
{"route": "/v1/generate", "sampling": {"mode": "hash", "key": "user_id", "rate": 0.01}, "redaction_profile": "default"}```
Sam: also add sample_reason metadata so ops can filter ("breakglass", "canary", "deterministic"). helps audits.
Priya: RBAC + approval flow is a must. breakglass should require 2 approvals for high-sensitivity routes and be time-limited (max 30m), with automatic purge of captured payloads after retention TTL.
Markus: console UX: toggle with three states: redact-only, audit-temp (record full, masked copy stored encrypted), metadata-only. show a red banner when audit-temp is active.
Linh: encryption-at-rest is obvious. but we also need pseudonymization option vs redaction — some teams want to keep analyzable tokens without raw PII. add profile types: mask, pseudonymize, remove.
Derek: on sampling: allow sample_weight so customers can upweight low-volume routes for observability without full capture on all requests. e.g., weight 10 = 10x chance.
Maya: question — do we let dedicated customers opt-out of sampling by contract? legal may require no capture for certain customers.
Priya: yes, add tenant-level exemption flag and display in console with linked contract ID.
Sam: ops-bot: https://deployments.company.internal/flags/BRK-102 created feature flag for breakglass; owner=@Maya.
Maya: acceptance criteria draft: 1) route-level sampling config, 2) redaction profiles (mask/pseudonymize/remove), 3) breakglass with RBAC/2-approvals/TTL, 4) telemetry events for every change (who/why), 5) canary rollout to staging then 10% prod.
Markus: rollout plan: start with internal + beta customers, monitor for data exfiltration signals, run privacy audit after beta.
Linh: implementation note: redaction should be deterministic for same keys so traces stay linkable but raw PII not stored. add a salt per-tenant for pseudonymization.
Derek: API addition: allow POST /admin/logging/config with payload and ETag-based concurrency. also add read-only endpoint for audit history.
Maya: ok i'll write RFC with config schema + console mocks. can someone volunteer to own the privacy review? @Priya?
Priya: I can own privacy review. will coordinate with legal.
Sam: I'll follow up on telemetry schema for sample_reason + sample_weight + rule_id.
Markus: I'll own the console changes and mockups.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please add feature-flagged work to the staging sprint board (board:eng-platform-staging).
Maya: thanks all — i'll post RFC link once drafted. :thumbsup:
